description: Free, no key, instant result. Without api_key: 5 own checks per client address per UTC day, shared by check_book and the finance tools; samples are never counted. A free key (get_free_key, no card, no e-mail) runs 20 own checks a day and 200 in all. Send budget and actual lines as JSON; returns MATCH/WARN/STOP per line (default 5%/20%, overridable per request, thresholds always echoed), ranked overruns (largest % overrun first). Overall = worst line status. Math only. Process-and-discard: nothing is stored or logged after the run. A request containing a Luhn-valid card number or a valid IBAN is refused before accept with reason sensitive_data_refused (not counted as a check). Desk: volume use. Top-level verdict is CLEAN, FLAGGED or NOT_VERIFIED. Per-line and overall status stay MATCH, WARN or STOP; those are not the top-level verdict.

api_key.description: Optional key (vdk_...). Same as the Bearer header.

currency.description: Optional currency code (e.g. GBP). Carried through but not used in checks.

lines.description: Budget vs actual lines. Each line needs line_id (string), budget (number) and actual (number). A line with budget 0 is reported as NOT_CHECKED (not a flag) and makes coverage incomplete.

period.description: Optional period label (e.g. 2026-09). Carried through but not validated.

thresholds.description: Optional threshold overrides. match_max_pct (default 5): overspend % at or below this is MATCH. warn_max_pct (default 20): overspend % above match_max_pct and at or below this is WARN; above is STOP. Both must be non-negative and warn_max_pct >= match_max_pct.
